name: Megali Idea
summary: The Megali Idea (Great Idea) is the Greek irredentist programme, named by Ioannis Kolettis in 1844, of uniting the Greeks still outside the kingdom in one state centred on Constantinople. It rests on the unity and continuity of Hellenism from antiquity through Byzantium, a mission to enlighten the East and the joining of Greek and Orthodox Christian identity. Its content was never fixed precisely, which let it serve as a unifying national aim through the 19th century.
scope: The Greek nationalist programme of national completion, as named in Kolettis's 14 January 1844 speech to the National Assembly and described by the Foundation of the Hellenic World and the scholarship on its emergence. Venizelos's 1919 memorandum and the 1919-22 war are not used: no defining source ties them to the idea's content. Wikipedia only served to find leads.
